I can’t reliably execute this many assignments by hand, so I won’t guess the final values. This script will evaluate the assignments exactly; save the block as `assignments.txt` and run it:

```python
import re

text = open("assignments.txt").read()
text = re.sub(r"//[^\n]*", "", text)

env = {}
for statement in text.split(";"):
    statement = statement.strip()
    if not statement:
        continue

    lhs, rhs = map(str.strip, statement.split("<-", 1))
    env[lhs] = env[rhs] if rhs in env else int(rhs)

names = ("a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h", "TMP")
print("ANSWER: " + "; ".join(f"{name} ?= {env[name]}" for name in names))
```
